text: Two translucent white plastic wash/squeeze bottles stand upright, side by side, on a white plate mounted to an aluminium extrusion frame. Each has a bright red screw cap with an angled bent dispensing spout; both caps are in place and the spouts point left/down-left. The left bottle carries a green band near its shoulder, the right bottle a blue band. Both appear to hold clear or colourless liquid, filled to roughly the mid-upper body. At right, a white circular recess or holder sits empty in the plate. Behind, two black vertical rods rise from a dark square base plate speckled with debris. Metal screws and hex fittings dot the white mounting plate; pale walls and lighting are in the background.
